detail.summary: This provisional notebook identifies the current state of architectural consensus as documented in recent surveys. While models like ACT-R and Soar provide structured approaches to cognitive modeling, explicit native mechanisms for 'error detection' or self-correction in the sense of metareasoning are not the primary focus of the documented consensus model.
detail.reason: To contextualize the study of self-correction mechanisms against the established 'Standard Model' of cognitive architecture.
